sourceLabel: Roll call · Ohio Senate floor votes (Ohio Legislature)

rollCalls.title: Prohibit specified actions with intent to steal a motor vehicle
rollCalls.summary: Gas and diesel fuel tax. Reduces the tax on gasoline and diesel fuel for a period of three months, from 38.5 ¢ per gallon for gasoline and 47¢ per gallon for diesel to 0.01¢ per gallon for either. Prohibits a licensed retail dealer or licensed motor fuel dealer from selling motor fuel during the temporary reduction period without passing the full benefit of the reduced tax onto the consumer or other purchaser. Provides that violation of the prohibition may be considered in any licensing determination made by the Tax Commissioner and referred to the Attorney General (AG).

rollCalls.title: Revise non-recourse litigation funding agreement regulations
rollCalls.summary: Overview. Repeals the law governing nonrecourse civil litigation advance contract s and replaces it with two subsets of regulations: one for commercial litigation financing agreements (“commercial agreements ”) and another for consumer legal funding agreements (“consumer agreements”). Contract requirements. Retains the majority of the contract-related requirements under former law, but limits application of those requirements to consumer agreements, i.e., contracts with an individual that resides in Ohio for less than $400,000.

rollCalls.title: Regards entities providing behind-the-meter utility services
Regards the sale of used catalytic converters
rollCalls.summary: Requires scrap metal dealers and other persons who purchase used catalytic converters to comply with certain additional recordkeeping, reporting, and process requirements. Imposes a penalty not to exceed $7,500 on a business entity that violates the above requirements. Expands the investigatory authority and noninvestigatory responsibilities of the Director of Public Safety relating to scrap metal dealers and other persons purchasing used catalytic converters. Prohibits a motor vehicle salvage dealer from purchasing or accepting catalytic converters.

rollCalls.title: Regards drone use by law enforcement; aviation facilities
rollCalls.summary: Criminal evidence derived from a UAV. Generally, requires a peace officer to obtain a court-issued search warrant to collect surveillance data using an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) if the peace officer otherwise would need a warrant to physically enter the house or place in person to conduct the search. Prohibits surveillance data and any information obtained from that data from being admitted as evidence in a criminal proceeding if it was gathered under circumstances that required a warrant and the warrant was not obtained.

rollCalls.title: Establish the Ohio Defense Commission
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Ohio Defense and Space Advisory Commission. Establishes the Defense and Aerospace Industry Expansion Program under which the Department of Development may make grants to support economic development related to the defense industry. Requires any entity that receives a grant under the program undergo an audit of the project administration. Makes an appropriation.

rollCalls.title: Regards funds provided by county for Memorial Day expenses
rollCalls.summary: Increases the amount a county may provide to military and veterans organizations for Memorial Day expenses. Increases from $100 to $200 the amount a county may appropriate to a civic organization for Memorial Day expenses.

rollCalls.title: Enact the School Bus Safety Act
rollCalls.summary: Criminal penalties for illegally passing a stopped school bus. Increases the criminal penalties for illegally passing a stopped school bus that is loading or unloading passengers by setting required minimum fines, increasing the maximum fines, increasing the length of the driver ’s license suspension, and imposing higher penalties and points on a driver’s license for repeat offenders.

rollCalls.title: Alter amusement ride classification for inspection fee purposes
rollCalls.summary: Amusement rides. Reclassifies the types of amusement rides for purposes of re-determining each ride ’s annual inspection and reinspection fee. Decreases the annual permit fee for an inflatable ride. Creates a formula to calculate the inspection and reinspection fee for an inflatable ride based on the number of rides that are inspected at the same time at the same location and owned by the same owner instead of a flat $104 fee per inflatable ride. Food regulation laws. Exempts a registered bakery from the requirement to obtain a frozen food facility license.

rollCalls.title: Regards the operation of public schools and the DEW
rollCalls.summary: State Board of Education. Increases the number of appointed State Board of Education members from five to seven. Requires the State Board, in some circumstances, to add additional grade levels to alternative resident educator license holders ’ licenses as requested by the educator ’s employing school district. Requires the State Board to automatically revoke or deny the renewal of any license issued to an individual who pleads guilty to, is found guilty of, or is convicted of domestic violence, strangulation, or grooming.

rollCalls.title: Waive ID, birth certificate fees for homeless individuals
rollCalls.summary: Absent voting by mail. Would have required an elector to provide photo identification ( ID) to vote by mail beginning with the November 2027, general election. Would have exempted certain electors from that requirement and provided alternative ID procedures for them. Would have allowed an elector to fulfill the photo ID requirement by providing it either when applying for ballots or when returning voted ballots to the board. Would have permitted an elector to show photo ID at the board’s office instead of making a copy.

rollCalls.title: Regards physician supervision of imaging contrast administration
rollCalls.summary: Administration of contrast – physician supervision. Revises the law authorizing a radiologist assistant to administer contrast media under the on-site supervision of a physician who is a radiologist, by also permitting the radiologist assistant to do so under the radiologist’s remote supervision. Authorizes a registered nurse, radiographer, radiation therapy technologist, and nuclear medicine technologist to administer contrast under the direct or general supervision of a physician.

rollCalls.title: Prohibit interfering with motor vehicle-related arrests
rollCalls.summary: Expands the offense of interfering with an officer who is arresting an offender for a violation of a criminal traffic or vehicle equipment law. Increases the penalty for this offense from a minor misdemeanor to a second degree misdemeanor. Creates a new offense that generally prohibits a vehicle operator or passenger from refusing to disclose the person’s name, address, or birthdate when requested by a peace officer who reasonably suspects that the person has committed a violation of certain offenses related to the laws governing motor vehicles and other modes of transit.

rollCalls.title: Revise list of vehicles that can commit vehicular homicide
rollCalls.summary: Regarding vehicles that can be used to commit vehicular homicide or assault, adds the following vehicles:  Under-speed vehicles (e.g., golf cart);  Motorized bicycles or mopeds;  Motor-driven cycles or motor scooters; and  All-purpose vehicles.

rollCalls.title: Designate Deputy Daniel "Weston" Sherrer Memorial Highway
Enact the Gus Frangos Act
rollCalls.summary: Board of revision recusal for land bank matters. Prohibits a member of a county ’s board of revision who also serves on the board of a county land reutilization corporation (CLRC), or who is also a member of the board of county commissioners of a county that is an electing subdivision, from participating in any case concerning the value of real property owned by the CLRC or electing subdivision. Requires such a member of the county’s board of revision to appoint a substitute official to participate in the case concerning the property owned by the CLRC or electing subdivision.

rollCalls.title: Enter into the Respiratory Care Interstate Compact
rollCalls.summary: Enters Ohio into the Respiratory Care Interstate Compact to facilitate the interstate practice of respiratory therapy with the goal of improving public access to respiratory therapy services by allowing licensed respiratory therapists to practice in other member states. Establishes requirements for respiratory therapist licensees, including active military members and their spouses, in Compact member states to practice in other member states.

rollCalls.title: Regards prescription drugs and medication switching
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits health insurers from taking certain actions with respect to a covered drug during a health benefit plan year, including increasing cost-sharing, removing the drug from the plan’s formulary, or otherwise limiting or reducing coverage of the drug. Exempts from the bill ’s provisions a drug for which the wholesale acquisition cost increases by more than 5% plus the rate of inflation during the plan year, as compared to the average wholesale acquisition cost for the previous plan year.

rollCalls.title: Regards timing of health insurer recoupment from providers
rollCalls.summary: Changes, from two years to one year, the period when:  A payment by a third-party payer to a health care provider is considered final; and  Overpayment recovery against a provider must be initiated. Prohibits a third-party payer from charging a health care provider for appealing an overcharge determination. Extends the period during which a provider may respond to an overpayment notice from 30 days to 60 days. Requires a third-party payer to give a provider a notice of overpayment electronically when using an electronic notification system agreed to by the company and provider.

rollCalls.title: Verify veteran status of imprisoned individuals
rollCalls.summary: Requires incarcerating institutions to investigate and verify the veteran status of individuals imprisoned or charged with a criminal offense punishable by incarceration. Specifies that a sheriff’s jail register must include a prisoner’s veteran status. Specifies that outreach and coordination programs established by a county veterans service commission may provide financial assistance to veterans treatment courts, and training and equipment for incarcerating institutions necessary to comply with the act’s requirements.

rollCalls.title: Regards academic intervention, math improvement and intervention
rollCalls.summary: Diagnostic assessments. Eliminates the requirement that the Department of Education and Workforce adopt one and approve five reading diagnostic assessments for grades K-3 and, instead, requires the Department to approve a list of six assessments. Adds a sixth math diagnostic assessment and provides that this assessment must be the one that scored the sixth highest in the Department’s most recent evaluation to the list of its approved math diagnostic assessments for grades K-3.

rollCalls.title: Revise the law governing oil and gas wells
rollCalls.summary: Oil and Gas Well Fund. Provides protections against executive branch raids of the Oil and Gas Well Fund. Specifies that the Division of Oil and Gas Resources Management, on behalf of the state, owns the right to carbon credits for any orphaned well plugged using state or federal money. Allows the Chief of the Division to enter into agreements to obtain or to sell carbon credits and directs any proceeds from the sale of carbon credits to the Oil and Gas Well Fund. ODNR authority to regulate interstate wells.

rollCalls.title: Authorize pharmacists to test, treat certain health conditions
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a pharmacist to conduct screenings, order and administer laboratory and diagnostic tests, evaluate the results of screenings and tests, and provide treatment to people who are at least five years old for specified health conditions. Requires the State Board of Pharmacy to develop a protocol for pharmacists to use when providing these services. Requires coverage of these pharmacist services by health insurers and Medicaid.

rollCalls.title: Require construction contracts note variation from standard form
rollCalls.summary: Requires that when a public construction contract uses an industry standard form, any changes to the standard terms must be indicated by marking up the contract, or the changes are not valid and the contract defaults to the industry standard.

rollCalls.title: Enact the Keep Them Safe Act
rollCalls.summary: Firearms storage arrangements. Allows a person who owns a firearm or is authorized by the owner of the firearm to store the firearm with a federally licensed firearms dealer or law enforcement agency under prescribed terms. Provides immunity from civil liability for a federally licensed firearms dealer who accepts storage of a firearm under the act, unless the dealer acts with malicious purpose or intent to withhold the return of the firearm without legal cause.

rollCalls.title: Ratify the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
rollCalls.summary: Interstate Compact for School Psychologists. Enters Ohio into the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists to improve public access to school psychological services by facilitating the interstate practice of school psychology in educational or school settings. As a member of the Compact, requires Ohio to offer equivalent licenses to school psychologists from another member state of the Compact, subject to Ohio ’s laws and rules governing school psychologists.

rollCalls.title: Declare the state's energy siting policy
rollCalls.summary: Declares Ohio’s public policy is to ensure affordable, reliable, and clean energy security within the state in all applications for a certificate from the Power Siting Board.

rollCalls.title: Regards the operation of public and chartered nonpublic schools
rollCalls.summary: “Cheating” resources. Prohibits organizations and individuals from engaging in any activities or advertising any services with the intention of assisting a learner to cheat on any exam or assigned task. Expressly permits an individual or organization to provide tutorial educational assistance to learners, provided the work product will not be represented as the learner’s own work. Permits the Attorney General to bring an action for a violation and subjects the violator to a civil penalty of not more than $5,000 per violation.

rollCalls.title: Enact the Enhanced Cybersecurity for SNAP Act
rollCalls.summary: Medicaid Program Integrity and Fraud Prevention Act Electronic visit verification (EVV) for in-home care services. Requires the Department of Medicaid to require each claim for a service that is subject to EVV requirements under state or federal law, including nonexempt services provided by in-home care service providers, to be supported by a validated EVV record as a condition of payment.

rollCalls.title: Revise X-ray machine operator and radiation technician law
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a general X-ray machine operator to perform radiologic procedures under the direct supervision of a certified nurse practitioner or physician assistant. In the case of a general X-ray machine operator who is a registered nurse and provides occupational health nursing services in an industrial workplace, clarifies that the registered nurse is not subject to a physician ’s general supervision if the nurse also is a certified nurse practitioner.

rollCalls.title: Require students complete a high school computer science course
rollCalls.summary: Computer science as a graduation requirement. Generally requires each student that first enters 9 th grade on or after July 1, 2029, to complete one-half unit of instruction in computer science to graduate. Makes a one-half unit computer science course count as one-half of an elective unit under the high school graduation requirements. Permits a student to substitute a full-unit computer science course for certain other courses and requires the Department of Education and Workforce to develop guidance for those substitutions.

rollCalls.title: Prohibit certain clauses from conservancy district contracts
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a conservancy district ’s board of directors from including certain provisions, such as an indemnification clause, in a contract for the procurement of goods or services.

rollCalls.title: Create the Adopt a Trail Program
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) Division of Parks and Watercraft to establish and administer the Adopt a Trail Program to allow volunteer groups to assist in maintaining and enhancing trails on state-owned land. Establishes general parameters for the program. Requires the Division Chief to adopt rules for the operation and implementation of the program.

rollCalls.title: Revise temporary instruction permit eligibility, requirements
rollCalls.summary: Driving age. Lowers the age at which a juvenile may obtain a temporary instruction permit from 15½ to 15. Expands the time a juvenile must hold a temporary instruction permit before eligib ility for a probationary license from six months to one year (thus retaining age 16 as the age of eligibility for a probationary driver’s license).

rollCalls.title: Increase time period to bring civil action for sex offense victim
rollCalls.summary: Raises the civil statute of limitations from one year to five years for an action brought against an individual for conduct prohibited as a sex offense.

rollCalls.title: Prohibit certain offenders from school or child care premises
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits qualified sex offender/child-victim offenders from knowingly being present on school, preschool, or child care center premises or on premises where a school-affiliated ticketed event is occurring, unless for a legitimate purpose. Requires the sheriff, or sheriff ’s designee, to notify qualified offenders of the above prohibition in writing at the time of the offender’s registration. Requires the Bureau of Criminal Identification and Investigation to include in the public record the identity of any qualified offender who is subject to the prohibition.

rollCalls.title: Regards employment status of health care workers for certain laws
rollCalls.summary: Specifies conditions under which a health care worker providing services to patients is not an employee of a healthcare worker platform or a healthcare facility for purposes of state overtime and minimum wage requirements, the Bi monthly Pay Law, the Workers’ Compensation Law, the Unemployment Compensation Law, and the Income Tax Law. Allows a healthcare worker platform to advertise to the public that the platform is seeking health care workers to use the platform.

rollCalls.title: Designate Congressman David Hobson Memorial Highway
rollCalls.summary: Designates multiple highways, an interchange, bridge, and overpass. Creates multiple new specialty license plates.

rollCalls.title: Urge Congress to enact the Ohio River Restoration Program Act
Urge Congress accelerate deployment of new energy infrastructure
Revise the Ohio Uniform Commercial Code
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a new Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Article 12 to provide rules for transactions involving certain new types of digital assets named controllable electronic records (CERs). Outlines how a person obtains control of a CER. Provides that a person with control can be anonymous, but must be positively identifiable in some manner, such as the use of a cryptographic key. Revises UCC Article 9 to facilitate the use of digital assets as collateral for loans.

rollCalls.title: Prohibit harassing or impeding an emergency service responder
rollCalls.summary: Creates new circumstances for the offense of obstructing official business. Increases the penalty for obstructing official business from a second degree misdemeanor to a first degree misdemeanor under specified circumstances involving an emergency service responder. Increases the penalty for obstructing official business from a second degree misdemeanor to a fourth degree felony if a violation creates a risk of physical harm to an emergency service responder.

rollCalls.title: Regards filing for certificate of qualification for employment
rollCalls.summary: Reduces the amount of time that a person must wait to apply for a certificat e of qualification for employment (CQE) if the person served a period of incarceration for a felony offense.

rollCalls.title: Regards emergency Joshua Alert system for certain missing kids
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies that if a missing child has autism spectrum disorder or another developmental disability, the local law enforcement agency must notify the Statewide Emergency Alert Program as soon as certain information has been verified. Names the alert for a missing child who has autism spectrum disorder or another developmental disability the Joshua Alert.

rollCalls.title: Support American Legion Buckeye Boys State, Buckeye Girls State
Regulate the ownership of electric vehicle charging stations
rollCalls.summary: Adds definitions for “electric vehicle ” and “electric vehicle charging station ” to Ohio ’s Competitive Retail Electric Services (CRES) laws. Declares electric vehicle charging station s are a CRES that consumers may obtain from any supplier, subject to Ohio’s CRES laws. Amends provisions of recently enacted S.B. 103 of the 136th General Assembly to ensure that water service line replacement costs and water service line replacement reimbursement amounts are included in the property valuation calculation of a utility that chooses to file for a forecasted test period.

rollCalls.title: Establish the Urban Farmer Youth Initiative Pilot Program
rollCalls.summary: Exempts temporary greenhouses from statutes governing the construction and condition of buildings and related rules adopted by the Board of Building Standards. Codifies an existing practice that allows noncontiguous land to be valued at its current agricultural use value, or CAUV, without meeting an income threshold, if the total acreage of all parcels used in a single agricultural operation in the same county equals at least ten acres.

rollCalls.title: Regards real property foreclosures and estate sales
rollCalls.summary: Residential appraisals. Specifies that persons conducting appraisals of residential property for foreclosure and execution sales must be either a realtor, broker, or appraiser licensed in Ohio. Specifies that the appraisers must not be affiliated with the sheriff or private selling officer conducting the sale. Reduces the time within which residential appraisals must be provided to the court, from 21 days to 14 days. Specifies that the cost of residential appraisals cannot exceed a “reasonable and customary amount,” as determined by the sheriff. Requires appraisals to be exterior only.

rollCalls.title: Allow certain public hospitality employees to accept gratuities
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a public employee working in certain hospitality settings to accept, in addition to the employee ’s regular compensation, a gratuity in recognition of services the employee performs in the course of the employee’s public employment.

rollCalls.title: Make capital appropriations for the biennium ending June 30, 2028
rollCalls.summary: Capital appropriations and reappropriations. Makes capital appropriations totaling $3. 7 billion for the FY 202 7-2028 biennium, and authorizes about $3.4 billion in new debt. Aging School Accelerator Pilot Program. Establishes the Aging School Accelerator Pilot Program under which the Facilities Construction Commission (FCC) must provide classroom facilities project assistance to qualifying school districts.

rollCalls.title: CA: Require identification to vote
rollCalls.summary: Proposes an amendment to the Ohio Constitution to appear on the ballot in November 2026, to require electors to provide identification (ID) to vote. Requires an elector to show photo ID when voting in person, provided that the General Assembly may allow an exception for those with a sincere religious objection to being photographed, as under the existing statute. Defines “photo identification” to include the same documents as are currently acceptable under the Revised Code.

rollCalls.title: Establish process to regulate carbon capture, storage technology
rollCalls.summary: Authority to regulate carbon sequestration. Declares that the regulation of carbon dioxide sequestration activities is a matter of general statewide interest that requires uniform statewide regulation. Generally, grants the Division of Oil and Gas Resources Management within the Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) sole and exclusive authority to regulate carbon sequestration.

rollCalls.title: Designate EMS week in Ohio
Reduce statute of limitations for contract actions
rollCalls.summary: Reduces the statute of limitations for contract actions.

rollCalls.title: Regards AI images, simulated child porn, replica identity fraud
rollCalls.summary: Generative artificial intelligence systems. Requires generative artificial intelligence systems (generative AI systems) be programmed to provide a distinctive watermark on generative AI system generated images or videos that informs the user that it was generated using a generative AI system. Requires covered provider s to include provenance data in any content created by the provider’s generative AI system.

rollCalls.title: Expand the Address Confidentiality Program
rollCalls.summary: Address Confidentiality Program. Expands eligibility for the Address Confidentiality Program operated by the Secretary of State for certain crime victims and their household members. Adds a victim of a crime that caused serious physical harm or death, a victim of a crime in which the victim was threatened with a deadly weapon, and a household member of such a victim to the list of eligible persons.

rollCalls.title: Allow registration of a humvee as a historical motor vehicle
rollCalls.summary: Allows the owner of a high-mobility multipurpose wheeled vehicle ( colloquially, a “Humvee”) that was manufactured for military purposes to register the vehicle either for general transportation an d operation on public roads and highways or for limited transportation related to participation in club activities, exhibitions, tours, parades, and similar uses.

rollCalls.title: Allow county comm to award a franchise for public transit system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a board of county commissioners, on its own behalf, to award a franchise for the operation of a public transit system. Requires a board of county commissioners to notify the county transit board 30 days before holding a vote to award a franchise.

rollCalls.title: Enact the Enhanced Cybersecurity for SNAP Act
rollCalls.summary: Medicaid Program Integrity and Fraud Prevention Act Electronic visit verification (EVV) for in-home care services. Requires the Department of Medicaid to require each claim for a service that is subject to EVV requirements under state or federal law, including nonexempt services provided by in-home care service providers, to be supported by a validated EVV record as a condition of payment.

rollCalls.title: Regards Education and Workforce Return on Investment Initiative
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Education and Workforce to develop professional skills standards aligned to the essential workplace skills needed by employers in Ohio. Requires the Department, in consultation with career education and workforce development stakeholders, to establish a statewide career coaching framework. Eliminates the student success plan requirement public schools must develop for students who are at risk of dropping out of high school.

rollCalls.title: Regards workers' compensation coverage-urban search and rescue
rollCalls.summary: Makes individuals who are members of a designated urban search and rescue team employees of the Ohio Emergency Management Agency for purposes of workers ’ compensation coverage.

rollCalls.title: Enact the Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact
rollCalls.summary: Enters Ohio into the Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact to provide a streamlined process that allows podiatric physicians to become licensed and practice in member states. Establishes requirements for podiatric physicians ’ expedited licensure under the Compact, including eligibility determination and application procedures. Authorizes joint investigations and adverse actions ( revocation, surrender, relinquishment in lieu of discipline, and suspension of license or imposition of sanctions) by member states against licensees.

rollCalls.title: Create the Blackout license plate
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV) to issue “Blackout” license plates, which have a black background, white lettering, and do not include the standard design or county identification stickers of Ohio license plates. Requires payment of a $40 license plate fee and a $10 administrative fee for purchase of the license plates, all of which goes to the BMV.

rollCalls.title: Regards sexually oriented offenses involving juveniles, animals
rollCalls.summary: Creates new circumstances for the existing offense of unlawful sexual conduct with a minor. Creates new circumstances for the existing offense of gross sexual imposition. Increases the penalty for sexual conduct with a minor when the other person is 13 years of age or older and less than 16 years of age and the offender is ten or more years older than the other person. Expands the offense of pandering obscenity involving a minor or impaired person to also prohibit pandering obscenity involving a depiction of a purported minor.

rollCalls.title: Require electronic recordings of all parole board hearings
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Chief of the Adult Parole Authority to adopt rules requiring that electronic recordings be made of Parole Board hearings. Makes electronic recordings of full Parole Board hearings public records. Clarifies that electronic recordings of institutional Parole Board release consideration hearings, revocation hearings, post-release control revocation hearings, and specified Parole Board hearings are not public records.

rollCalls.title: Regards use of light-based medical devices for hair removal
rollCalls.summary: Revises the law governing the application – by specified individuals under physician delegation – of light-based medical devices for the purpose of hair removal, including by labeling certain of these individuals as “laser hair removal professionals.”. Limits application of the requirement that a delegating physician evaluate a patient before and after the first use of the light-based medical device to procedures performed by a laser hair professional, rather than procedures performed by any physician delegate.

rollCalls.title: Regards limestone, dolomite mining; increase severance taxes
rollCalls.summary: Underground minerals mining program. Creates a new regulatory program for underground limestone and dolomite (“underground minerals”) mining operations. Accordingly, establishes application and permitting processes and timelines for the issuance of underground minerals mining operation permits by the Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) Chief of the Division of Mineral Resources Management.

rollCalls.title: Enact the Chief Steven DiSario Act
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits manufactured home park operators and landlords from including a restriction in a rental agreement or otherwise prohibiting the display of a thin blue line flag or emblem. Prohibits neighborhood, civic, homeowners, and condominium associations from including a provision in a governing document that prohibits the display of a thin blue line flag or emblem, subject to specified conditions. Declares such a prohibited provision to be void as against public policy. Names the bill after Police Chief Steven DiSario.

rollCalls.title: Exempt armed forces-certified child care provider from licensure
rollCalls.summary: Exempts family child care providers certified by the U.S. armed forces from the law governing the regulation of child care providers, including the requirement that certain family child care homes be licensed by the Department of Children and Youth.

rollCalls.title: Clarify that child independent activity is not abuse or neglect
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies that a child who is granted permission to engage in independent activities is not considered to be an abused or neglected child.

rollCalls.title: Require school building to have an exterior secure master key box
rollCalls.summary: Requires each public and chartered nonpublic school to install at least one exterior secure master key box for each school building that is assigned an internal retrieval number by the Department of Education and Workforce. Requires secure master key boxes to be installed on a school building or in a strategic location for optimal law enforcement response on school premises. Permits the Attorney General to provide School Safety Training Grants for the purchase and installation of an exterior secure master key box.

rollCalls.title: Allow tax increment financing for police, firefighting facilities
rollCalls.summary: Specifically allows payments made in lieu of taxes (PILOTs) under tax increment financing (TIF) arrangements to be used for police and fire buildings.

rollCalls.title: Designate Trooper Nicholas P. Cayton Memorial Highway
Require certain facilities assist inmates in obtaining ID cards
rollCalls.summary: Expands a program through which certain prison inmates are provided assistance in obtaining a state identification card (“ID card”) prior to their release from confinement. Specifically, adds inmates completing programming at a community-based correctional facility and program, a district community-based correctional facility and program, or a halfway house to the ID card program.

rollCalls.title: Regards student use of a nasal epinephrine delivery device
rollCalls.summary: Permits public and private schools and camps to procure epinephrine nasal sprays and other epinephrine devices or products approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for use in emergency situations in the same capacity as epinephrine autoinjectors. Permits students to possess and use such a device or product in public and private schools and camps. Requires the Ohio State Board of Pharmacy to adopt rules designating devices or other products that are FDA-approved for administering a premeasured dose of epinephrine that may be used in schools and camps.

rollCalls.title: Regards timing of health insurer recoupment from providers
rollCalls.summary: Changes, from two years to one year, the period when:  A payment by a third-party payer to a health care provider is considered final; and  Overpayment recovery against a provider must be initiated. Prohibits a third-party payer from charging a health care provider for appealing an overcharge determination. Extends the period during which a provider may respond to an overpayment notice from 30 days to 60 days. Requires a third-party payer to give a provider a notice of overpayment electronically when using an electronic notification system agreed to by the company and provider.

rollCalls.title: Permit monetary damages against municipal corps with gun controls
rollCalls.summary: Expands the nature of damages an individual may seek against a municipal corporation, which enacts or enforces gun control measures, to include punitive or exemplary damages.

rollCalls.title: Enter into the Athletic Trainer Compact
rollCalls.summary: Enters Ohio into the Athletic Trainer Compact to expand mobility of athletic training practice with the goal of improving public access to athletic training services by allowing licensed athletic trainers to practice in other member states. Establishes requirements for athletic trainer licensees, including active military members and their spouses, in Compact member states to practice in other member states. Authorizes adverse actions ( administrative, civil, equitable, or criminal action ) against, and joint investigations of, licensees by member and remote states.

rollCalls.title: Regards carrying of firearms by certain special police officers
rollCalls.summary: Generally prohibits the Director of Behavioral Health and Director of Developmental Disabilities from prohibiting a special police officer from carrying or possessing a firearm when on duty on behalf of an institution under the jurisdiction of either department. Prohibits a special police officer from possessing, carrying, or discharging a firearm while on duty on behalf of an institution unless the officer satisfies requirements established by the Department of Behavioral Health and Department of Developmental Disabilities.

rollCalls.title: Designate Cleveland Police Officer Jamieson Ritter Memorial Hwy
Make capital reappropriations for biennium ending June 30, 2028
rollCalls.summary: Makes capital reappropriations for the biennium ending June 30, 2028 (FYs 2027 and 2028) and other appropriations. Makes various supplemental appropriations and earmarks.

rollCalls.title: Remove firearm mufflers, suppressors as dangerous ordnance
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to acquire, have, carry, or use a firearm muffler or suppressor. Removes firearm mufflers or suppressors from the classification of dangerous ordnance. Provides that under Ohio law, an owner of a firearm muffler or suppressor is no longer required to register the firearm muffler or suppressor in the National Firearms Registration and Transfer Record.

rollCalls.title: Designate Abbey Gate Remembrance Day
Change Ohio Deaf History Month to the month of April
Create the Land of U.S. Grant license plate
Regards insurance transactions, plans, and policies
rollCalls.summary: Special purpose financial captive insurance companies. Adds that the Superintendent of Insurance may, on request, admit an unimpaired asset held by a special purpose financial captive insurance company ( SPFCIC) or any affiliated entity which is intended to secure the reinsurance obligations of such parties, or which is not recognized as such in the N ational Association of Insurance Commissioner’s Accounting (NAIC) Practices and Procedures Manual. Provides that an admitted unimpaired asset must be treated as a public document after the date the asset was approved.

rollCalls.title: Allow law enforcement to provide certain school resource services
rollCalls.summary: Permits a chartered nonpublic school to generally engage for school resource officer services in the same manner as a school district does under continuing law. Permits a chartered nonpublic school, prior to the 2026-2027 school year, to engage a school resource officer who has not, as otherwise required under continuing law, completed prescribed training and been appointed under a memorandum of understanding between the school and a law enforcement agency.

rollCalls.title: Designate Officer Jacob J. Derbin Memorial Highway
Establish licensing process, contract requirements for PBMs
rollCalls.summary: PBM licensure. Establishes a stand-alone licensing process for pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) beginning July 1, 2027, and on that date, excludes PBMs from regulation under the third-party administrator (TPA) licensure law. Prohibits a person from soliciting a health plan sponsor or providing pharmacy benefit management services in Ohio without a PBM license, and makes it a fourth degree misdemeanor for a person to knowingly do so. Prescribes eligibility criteria for a PBM license depending on if the applicant is an individual, a business entity, or a nonresident licensed in another state.

rollCalls.title: Regards recording of certain real property documents
rollCalls.summary: Liens. Requires a lien creditor to provide the last known address of a lien debtor when filing a lien relating to unpaid child support and personal property taxes. Requires a lien creditor to provide the name of the lien debtor and last known address when filing a lien relating to workers compensation, unemployment compensation, sales taxes, income taxes, or severance taxes. Recording of a memorandum of trust. Requires a memorandum of trust or other qualifying instrument to be “of record” when an interest in real property is conveyed by the trustee of a disclosed trust.

rollCalls.title: Require construction contracts note variation from standard form
rollCalls.summary: Requires that when a public construction contract uses an industry standard form, any changes to the standard terms must be indicated by marking up the contract, or the changes are not valid and the contract defaults to the industry standard.

rollCalls.title: Regards professional employer organizations and Unemployment Law
rollCalls.summary: Allows a professional employer organization (PEO), alternate employer organization (AEO), or PEO reporting entit y to elect to report shared employees of a client employer under the account and experience rate of the PEO, AEO, or PEO reporting entity for purposes of reporting that information under the Unemployment Compensation Law, rather than using a separate, unique subaccount, as required under former law.

rollCalls.title: Prohibit use of ranked choice voting; withhold funding for use
rollCalls.summary: Ranked choice voting. Prohibits any election from being conducted in Ohio using ranked choice voting, also known as instant runoff voting. Allows a county or municipal corporation to use its home rule powers under the Ohio Constitution to adopt a ranked choice voting system, but financially penalizes a local government that does so. Makes a county or municipal corporation that approves the use of ranked choice voting via a resolution or ordinance ineligible to receive distributions from the Local Government Fund until it rescinds the resolution or ordinance.

rollCalls.title: Define antisemitism; expand the offense of ethnic intimidation
rollCalls.summary: Expands the offense of ethnic intimidation to include the offenses of riot and aggravated riot committed by reason of the race, color, religion, or national origin of another person or group of persons. Defines antisemitism for the purpose of certain investigations and proceedings by state agencies. Requires anti-discrimination and anti-bias training for state agency employees to use the bill’s definition of antisemitism as an educational tool to familiarize staff and officials with antisemitism.

rollCalls.title: Incorporate Internal Revenue Code changes into Ohio law
rollCalls.summary: Incorporates changes to federal tax law taking effect since March 7, 202 5, into Ohio income tax law. Declares an emergency.

rollCalls.title: Modify excavation requirements
rollCalls.summary: One call utility protection service. Requires protection services to create and maintain databases to collect and track underground facility damage notifications made in accordance with the reporting duties of excavators, and provide certain information for the purpose of improving excavation safety, damage prevention education, and transparency.

rollCalls.title: Revise the practice of certified registered nurse anesthetists
rollCalls.summary: Eliminates the requirement that a certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA) practice with supervision, which was defined as practicing under a physician’s, podiatrist ’s, or dentist’s direction. Requires, instead, that a CRNA practice in collaboration, defined as meaning that a physician, podiatrist, or dentist has requested the CRNA to perform patient care activities.

rollCalls.title: Regulate the ownership of electric vehicle charging stations
rollCalls.summary: Adds definitions for “electric vehicle ” and “electric vehicle charging station ” to Ohio ’s Competitive Retail Electric Services (CRES) laws. Declares electric vehicle charging station s are a CRES that consumers may obtain from any supplier, subject to Ohio’s CRES laws. Amends provisions of recently enacted S.B. 103 of the 136th General Assembly to ensure that water service line replacement costs and water service line replacement reimbursement amounts are included in the property valuation calculation of a utility that chooses to file for a forecasted test period.

rollCalls.title: Regards the timeline for restoring competency in criminal cases
rollCalls.summary: Increases in some instances, the time during which a criminal defendant may be held, prior to trial, for purposes of restoring the defendant’s competency. Tolls or restarts the time limit for restoration of competency under certain circumstances. Applies retroactively to any criminal defendant found incompetent to stand trial prior to February 20, 2026, and whose restoration to competency is ongoing or whose case remains pending. Declares an emergency.

rollCalls.title: Revise fees for the administration of a probate estate
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court, under specified circumstances, to escalate the lien priority of costs, expenses, and fees incurred by the executor or administrator of an estate, when apportioning the proceeds of a sale of real property owned by the estate. Limits the amount of estate administrative fees that can be escalated in terms of lien priority to $5,000.

rollCalls.title: Urge Congress to designate Buckeye Trail a National Scenic Trail
Encourage students to read the U.S. Declaration of Independence
Allow certain natural gas suppliers to offer carbon offsets
rollCalls.summary: Requires a retail natural gas supplier (RNGS) that intends to establish a voluntary carbon offset program to enter into an agreement with one or more carbon offset registries and submit a notice to the Public Utilities Commission (PUCO) that meets various requirements. Prohibits a voluntary carbon offset program offered by a RNGS from requiring a natural gas company or nonparticipating customers to incur program-related costs. Requires a RNGS’s voluntary carbon offset program to include procedures allowing customers to opt-in and out the program.

rollCalls.title: Designate Clarence "Sonny" Smith, Jr. Memorial Highway.
Create the Lifetown license plate
Revise medical and adult-use marijuana laws; levy marijuana taxes
rollCalls.summary: Overview. Repeals the Cannabis Control Law and combines regulations concerning the cultivation, processing, dispensing, use, and home grow of adult-use and medical marijuana into one chapter, referred to in this analysis as the Marijuana Control Law. Condenses the operations of the Division of Cannabis Control ( DCC) and the Division of Marijuana Control (DMC) into DCC. Product regulations. Prohibits possession or use of marijuana that is not acquired from a licensed Ohio dispensary or cultivated at the adult-use consumer ’s primary residence in accordance with the Marijuana Control Law.

rollCalls.title: Regards age requirements for kindergarten admission
rollCalls.summary: Requires public schools to admit to kindergarten any child who will be five years old or, if the child has not completed first grade, six years old, by the first day of instruction of the school year of admittance. Requires the Department of Education and Workforce to address a scoring error on the 2024-2025 biology end-of-course exam, including by increasing the scores of students negatively affected by it.

rollCalls.title: Limit ability to reallocate certain school property tax millage
rollCalls.summary: Requires that current expense fixed-sum levies be included in the calculation of a school district’s 20-mill floor or a joint vocational school district ’s 2-mill floor for property tax purposes, as follows:  Includes existing emergency and substitute levies in the first tax year, beginning in tax year 2026, in which a county in which the district has territory undergoes a reappraisal or triennial update.  Includes existing growth and conversion levies and fixed-sum property taxes levied with a school district income tax beginning in tax year 2026.

rollCalls.title: Prescribe limitations on intercollegiate athlete contracts
rollCalls.summary: Contracts with intercollegiate athletes. Prohibits any person from entering into a name, image, or likeness (NIL) contract with an intercollegiate athlete if the contract remains in effect or requires the athlete to provide future compensation or rights associated with the use of the athlete’s NIL after the athlete’s intercollegiate athletic eligibility ends.

rollCalls.title: Regards school district property taxes, school funding formula
rollCalls.summary: Tax credit for property in school districts on 20-mill floor. Authorizes a property tax credit for the owners of property located in a school district on the 20-mill floor property tax floor, with the goal of limiting a district’s total property tax revenue growth from the floor to the rate of inflation. Applies to all eligible property in the state beginning in tax year 2025.

rollCalls.title: Require certain construction industry employers to use E-verify
rollCalls.summary: Nonresidential construction hiring and retention requirements. Requires a nonresidential construction contractor, subcontractor, or labor broker to verify each new employee’s work eligibility through the federal E-Verify program (which is a program that helps an employer to determine the eligibility of its employees to work in the U.S.). Requires a nonresidential construction contractor, subcontractor, or labor broker to keep a record of the verification for the duration of the employee’s employment or three years, whichever is longer.

rollCalls.title: Revise dog law, including dangerous and vicious dogs
rollCalls.summary: Nuisance, dangerous, and vicious dog acts. Redefines what constitutes a nuisance, dangerous, and vicious dog. Penalties for dog attacks. Imposes criminal penalties on a dog owner or an animal shelter for dogs if:  The dog owner negligently fails to keep their dog from committing, without provocation, a “nuisance dog act,” “dangerous dog act,” or “vicious dog act,” including in circumstances in which the dog has not previously engaged in such an act;  The animal shelter for dogs recklessly fails to keep the dog from committing such acts.

rollCalls.title: Regards inmates' access to feminine hygiene products and showers
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits county and municipal correctional facilities and state correctional institutions housing female inmates from denying inmates access to feminine hygiene products, except when experiencing an emergency. Requires county and municipal correctional facilities and state correctional institutions housing female inmates to provide inmates experiencing a menstrual cycle with an adequate supply of feminine hygiene products at no cost to the inmates.

rollCalls.title: Regards budget commissions, property tax, and certain funds
rollCalls.summary: County budget commissions. Limits a requirement that county budget commissions (CBCs) approve all properly authorized voted property tax levies without modification to only the first year of a levy’s collection. Authorizes CBCs to reduce property tax levies, provided they are not otherwise required to approve them without modification, to avoid unnecessary or excessive collections.

rollCalls.title: Regards county budget commissions, property and sales tax, funds
rollCalls.summary: Requires each county budget commission (CBC), in the county ’s reappraisal or update year, to adjust the rate of each inside millage levy to limit any increase in its revenue to the GDP deflator growth over the three preceding years. Allows a subdivision to request that the CBC increase the levy rate to collect the same amount as the previous year if the subdivision’s inside millage collections would not increase in a reappraisal year.

rollCalls.title: Regards the Board of Nursing and criminal records check results
rollCalls.summary: Revises the law governing the Ohio Board of Nursing and criminal records checks, including by consolidating, in one statute, references to the types of individuals required to undergo Board-related checks. Specifically requires an individual, when requesting a criminal records check for Board of Nursing purposes, to submit one complete set of fingerprint impressions directly to the Superintendent of the Bureau of Criminal Identification and Investigation.

rollCalls.title: Designate Henrietta Lacks Day
Regards academic intervention, math improvement and intervention
rollCalls.summary: Diagnostic assessments. Eliminates the requirement that the Department of Education and Workforce adopt one and approve five reading diagnostic assessments for grades K-3 and, instead, requires the Department to approve a list of six assessments. Adds a sixth math diagnostic assessment and provides that this assessment must be the one that scored the sixth highest in the Department’s most recent evaluation to the list of its approved math diagnostic assessments for grades K-3.

rollCalls.title: Authorize conveyance of state-owned land.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes 14 transactions for the sale or transfer of state-owned land or the granting of easements on state-owned land.

rollCalls.title: Revise the law governing oil and gas wells
rollCalls.summary: Oil and Gas Well Fund. Provides protections against executive branch raids of the Oil and Gas Well Fund. Specifies that the Division of Oil and Gas Resources Management, on behalf of the state, owns the right to carbon credits for any orphaned well plugged using state or federal money. Allows the Chief of the Division to enter into agreements to obtain or to sell carbon credits and directs any proceeds from the sale of carbon credits to the Oil and Gas Well Fund. ODNR authority to regulate interstate wells.

rollCalls.title: Designate the buckeye as the state candy
rollCalls.summary: Designates the buckeye as the State candy. Corrects the scientific name of the Buckeye, the State tree.

rollCalls.title: Designate Black Ohioan Civil War Medal of Honor Recipient Day
Enact the Keep Them Safe Act
rollCalls.summary: Firearms storage arrangements. Allows a person who owns a firearm or is authorized by the owner of the firearm to store the firearm with a federally licensed firearms dealer or law enforcement agency under prescribed terms. Provides immunity from civil liability for a federally licensed firearms dealer who accepts storage of a firearm under the act, unless the dealer acts with malicious purpose or intent to withhold the return of the firearm without legal cause.

rollCalls.title: Revise deadline to return absent voter ballots
rollCalls.summary: Absentee ballot deadline. Requires all regular absentee ballots that are returned by mail to be delivered to the appropriate board of elections by the close of the polls (7:30 p.m.) on Election Day to be counted, eliminating a four-day grace period for those ballots under prior law. Electors’ U.S. citizenship. Changes the process the Secretary of State (SOS) must use to review the Statewide Voter Registration Database to identify non-U.S. citizens.

rollCalls.title: Enact the Historical Educational Displays Act
rollCalls.summary: Requires public schools that receive donations to display at least four from a list of nine founding documents in each classroom in which students in any of grades 4-12 are provided instruction in history or social studies. Requires schools to determine the amount of funds necessary to comply with the bill ’s provisions and permits them to accept donated funds or displays. Permits a school to erect on any school grounds or premises a monument inscribed with one or more of the documents.

rollCalls.title: Modify process for property tax sales-assessment ratio studies
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Taxation ( TAX) to consider only a representative sample of arm’s length property sales submitted by county auditors when conducting sales assessment ratio studies as part of its function to adjust, or “equalize,” proposed property values. Authorizes TAX to appeal a county auditor ’s sample as unreasonable or unlawful to the Board of Tax Appeals (BTA).

rollCalls.title: Honor the United States Navy; commemorate its 250th anniversary
Recognize the 250th anniversary of the United States Marine Corps
Recognize 250th anniversary of United States Army, Chaplain Corps
Regards allocation of parenting responsibilities
rollCalls.summary: Allocation of parenting responsibilities. Establishes a state public policy to foster and continue the relationship between the child and each parent when allocating parenting responsibilities and for each parent to have parenting time and participate in decision-making regarding the child, when i t is in the child’s best interest. Replaces the concept of “residential parent and legal custodian” with “designated parent and legal custodian ” of a child and repeals the concepts of shared parenting and sole custody.

rollCalls.title: Designate Ohio State Highway Patrol Lt. Vance M. Andrews Mem Hwy
Ratify the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists
rollCalls.summary: Interstate Compact for School Psychologists. Enters Ohio into the Interstate Compact for School Psychologists to improve public access to school psychological services by facilitating the interstate practice of school psychology in educational or school settings. As a member of the Compact, requires Ohio to offer equivalent licenses to school psychologists from another member state of the Compact, subject to Ohio ’s laws and rules governing school psychologists.

rollCalls.title: Regards the timeline for restoring competency in criminal cases
rollCalls.summary: Increases in some instances, the time during which a criminal defendant may be held, prior to trial, for purposes of restoring the defendant’s competency. Tolls or restarts the time limit for restoration of competency under certain circumstances. Applies retroactively to any criminal defendant found incompetent to stand trial prior to February 20, 2026, and whose restoration to competency is ongoing or whose case remains pending. Declares an emergency.

rollCalls.title: Regulate imitation meat and egg products
rollCalls.summary: Manufactured-protein food products. Specifies that food is misbranded as a meat product or egg product if certain conditions exist, including if the food contains a manufactured-protein food product or fabricated- egg product and the label for the food implies that it includes meat or eggs without qualification. Requires the Directors of Health and Job and Family Services to submit waiver requests to the U.S.

rollCalls.title: Designate Dr. Steven Takacs Veteran Memorial Highway
Allow wild animal rehab facility to get euthanasia drug permit
rollCalls.summary: Wild animal rehabilitation facilities. Authorizes the State Board of Pharmacy to issue a limited license to a wild animal rehabilitation facility (WARF) solely for purchasing, possessing, and administering drugs for euthanizing animals and pre-euthanizing drugs for inducing anesthesia, sedation, or unconsciousness. Prohibits a WARF’s agent or employee from performing euthanasia by lethal injection, or administering pre-euthanasia drugs, unless the WARF in which the agent or employee works is licensed.

rollCalls.title: Revise the real estate wholesaler law
rollCalls.summary: Requires wholesalers acting as the grantee in a transaction that conveys an interest in residential real property to make certain disclosures to the property owner. Allows the property owner to cancel a contract with a wholesaler that fails to make those disclosures, without penalty, any time before the close of escrow. Requires the escrow or closing agent to disburse any earnest money paid by a wholesaler to the record owner within 30 days after such a cancelation.

rollCalls.title: Make changes to the telemarketing law
rollCalls.summary: Replaces exemptions for certain voice service providers from the prohibition against providing substantial assistance or support to telemarketers violating federal law with exemptions for certain telecommunications carriers and issuers of securities.

rollCalls.title: Create the Law Enforcement Purple Heart license plate
Designate Abbey Gate Remembrance Day
Create the American Motorcyclist Association license plate
Revise deadline to return absent voter ballots
rollCalls.summary: Absentee ballot deadline. Requires all regular absentee ballots that are returned by mail to be delivered to the appropriate board of elections by the close of the polls (7:30 p.m.) on Election Day to be counted, eliminating a four-day grace period for those ballots under prior law. Electors’ U.S. citizenship. Changes the process the Secretary of State (SOS) must use to review the Statewide Voter Registration Database to identify non-U.S. citizens.

rollCalls.title: Create the escaped convict alert program
rollCalls.summary: Creates the Escaped Convict Alert Program. Provides that, upon the application of a prior parent company of a bank, the Secretary of State may appoint and commission police officers for the bank that the prior parent company of the bank previously had a controlling interest in.

rollCalls.title: Exempt military driver's license applicants from driver's ed
rollCalls.summary: Budget corrections Limited term license: education requirements. Exempts certain military-related limited term license applicants from the driver ’s education requirements. TMUD tax credit transfers. Modifies the procedure for transferring a transformational mixed-use development (TMUD) tax credit. Water pipe grants. Removes from the Workforce Housing Project Grant Program the grant metric that favored polyvinyl chloride water pipe over ductile iron. OBM authority to award funds for cultural facilities.

rollCalls.title: Designate CPL David James Amheiser Memorial Highway
Regards educator license grade bands
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Board of Education to specify whether an educator is licensed to teach grades pre-K through 5, grades 4 through 8, or grades 7 through 12. Requires the State Board to at least issue licenses for grades pre-K through 5 that authorize a license holder to provide either general education instruction or both general and special education instruction. Requires the State Board to at least issue a license for grades 4 through 8 that authorizes a license holder to provide general education instruction.

rollCalls.title: Codify the common law action for piercing the corporate veil
rollCalls.summary: Enacts elements that must be proved with respect to the liability of a covered person of a covered entity for damages or other penalties under the common law doctrine of “piercing the corporate veil.”. Provides that a covered person has no obligation to, and has no liability to any governmental entity for damages or other penalties unless the governmental entity seeks to pierce the corporate veil and demonstrates specified preconditions.

rollCalls.title: Establish road rules around distressed stationary vehicles
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits failing to change lanes or proceeding with caution around a stationary vehicle that is in distress. Expressly requires drivers to slow down to below the posted speed limit if they cannot safely change lanes under the Move Over Law.

rollCalls.title: Revise medical and adult-use marijuana laws; levy marijuana taxes
rollCalls.summary: Overview. Repeals the Cannabis Control Law and combines regulations concerning the cultivation, processing, dispensing, use, and home grow of adult-use and medical marijuana into one chapter, referred to in this analysis as the Marijuana Control Law. Condenses the operations of the Division of Cannabis Control ( DCC) and the Division of Marijuana Control (DMC) into DCC. Product regulations. Prohibits possession or use of marijuana that is not acquired from a licensed Ohio dispensary or cultivated at the adult-use consumer ’s primary residence in accordance with the Marijuana Control Law.

rollCalls.title: Designate Specialist Jacob A. Ashton Memorial Bridge
rollCalls.summary: Designates a bridge in Lake County as the “Specialist Jacob A. Ashton Memorial Bridge”. Updates the name and sponsoring organization of the “Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation” license plate to the “Breakthrough T1D ” license plate to reflect the organization’s name change.

rollCalls.title: Regards law enforcement training and competitive examinations
rollCalls.summary: Allows a police department to fill a vacant position in the classified civil service without a competitive examination if the department presents evidence that competition is impracticable and the position can best be filled by a person holding a specializ ed certification, possessing peculiar and exceptional qualifications, or having completed the department’s police cadet training program.

rollCalls.title: Regards the success sequence curriculum
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Education and Workforce to review and maintain a list of curriculum for the success sequence for grades 6-12. Requires school districts to provide instruction on the success sequence in at least one course required for high school graduation.

rollCalls.title: Require ODNR discount program for veterans, service members
rollCalls.summary: Requires the ODNR Chief of the Division of Parks and Watercraft to establish a discount program for veterans and service members for state park services and rentals.

rollCalls.title: Allow alternative rate plans for certain natural gas companies
rollCalls.summary: Forecasted test periods and property valuation. Allows a natural gas, water-works, and sewage disposal system company (“utility company”) to propose a forecasted test period, consisting of three consecutive 12-month periods, in the same manner as an electric light company (ELC) under continuing law, which includes the following:  Being subject to the same property valuation and reporting requirements as ELCs;  Providing any financial information from the utility company ’s full books, which the Public Utilities Commission (PUCO) must protect from disclosure of trade secrets or proprietary…

rollCalls.title: Authorize conveyance of state-owned land.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes 14 transactions for the sale or transfer of state-owned land or the granting of easements on state-owned land.

rollCalls.title: Regards supported decision-making for certain disabled adults
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a presumption that all adults with developmental disabilities are competent, unless otherwise determined by a court. Provides for the establishment of supported decision-making plans between an adult with developmental disabilities (the principal) and one or more supporters. Provides that evidence of a supported decision-making plan is an alternative to guardianship. Imposes duties on the Department of Developmental Disabilities regarding supported decision-making plans.

rollCalls.title: Regards courts and court procedures
rollCalls.summary: Requires the following rules adopted by municipal court judges to be in accordance with the Rules of Superintendence for the Courts of Ohio: (a) rules of practice and procedure, (b) rules relating to the administration of the court, and (c) generally those types of rules of judges of a municipal court’s housing or environmental division. Removes the provision in existing law authorizing a party defendant to withhold setting up a statement of counterclaim and make the counterclaim the subject of a separate action.

rollCalls.title: Designate CPT Louis John Speidel Memorial Highway
Require hospitals to provide overdose reversal drugs
rollCalls.summary: Generally requires a hospital to provide an overdose reversal drug to a patient at the time of the patient ’s discharge, if the patient presented to the hospital ’s emergency department with symptoms of opioid use disorder or overdose. Requires the Department of Behavioral Health to provide overdose reversal drugs to hospitals, subject to available funds. Permits a hospital to seek insurance or Medicaid reimbursement for overdose reversal drug costs, but only if the drugs were provided to patients from a supply purchased by the hospital.

rollCalls.title: Create the COSI specialty license plate
Regards operating under the influence of marihuana, OVI evidence
rollCalls.summary: Marijuana and OVI. Increases the per se prohibited concentration limits for marijuana (tetrahydrocannabinol, or THC) as measured via a chemical test of a person ’s whole blood from two nanograms per milliliter to five nanograms per milliliter for purposes of determining an automatic violation of the OVI1 laws (for both vehicles and watercraft). Removes measurements of marijuana metabolites and measurements via a chemical test of a person ’s urine or blood serum or plasma for purposes of determining a per se violation of the prohibited concentration limits for marijuana.

rollCalls.title: Enact Keith’s Law regarding the communication disability database
rollCalls.summary: Expands eligibility for the communication disability database maintained by the Department of Public Safety (DPS) so that persons with additional specified disabilities may be included. Makes the database available to emergency medical service personnel, firefighters, and law enforcement officers through each countywide 9-1-1 system, in addition to it continuing to be available to law enforcement officers through the Law Enforcement Automated Data System (LEADS).

rollCalls.title: Regards school policies on administering overdose reversal drugs
rollCalls.summary: School policy on overdose reversal drugs. Requires any public or nonpublic school that elects to keep a supply of an overdose reversal drug for an emergency situation to adopt and implement a policy regarding the supply’s maintenance and drug’s use. Permits a school to accept monetary donations for purchasing overdose reversal drugs. Requires a school superintendent to report any emergency use of an overdose reversal drug to the school’s governing body and the parent or guardian of the student to whom the drug was administered as soon as practicable after that use.

rollCalls.title: Make state operating appropriations for FY 2026-27
rollCalls.summary: This analysis is arranged by state agency in alphabetical order. Items that do not directly involve an agency are located under the agency that has regulatory authority over the item or otherwise deals with the subject matter of the item. After the last agency (the Department of Youth Services), separate chapters address the following: 1. Election Law, addressing the replacement of the Ohio Elections Commission and other elections matters; 2. Sports facilities and unclaimed funds; 3. Boards and commissions; 4. Local government; 5. Low-income utility assistance and block grants; 6.

rollCalls.title: Support work of the Ohio Commission for U.S. Semiquincentennial
Designate Lt. James A. Kirkendall Memorial Highway
Make appropriations for the Industrial Commission for FY 2026-27
Make state operating appropriations for FY 2026-27
rollCalls.summary: This analysis is arranged by state agency in alphabetical order. Items that do not directly involve an agency are located under the agency that has regulatory authority over the item or otherwise deals with the subject matter of the item. Low-income utility assistance and block grants; 6.

rollCalls.title: Designate John E. Gallagher Way
Create Play Golf Ohio license plate
Designate PFC John Wayne Richard Memorial Highway
Revise age for discounted hunting, fishing licenses and permits
rollCalls.summary: Lowers the age, from 66 to 65, at which an Ohio resident may obtain certain discounted senior hunting or fishing licenses or permits.

rollCalls.title: Enact the Agriculture Appreciation Act
rollCalls.summary: Designates the following:  The first week of October as “Ohio Stormwater Awareness Week”  March 21 as “Agriculture Day”;  The week beginning on the Saturday before the last Saturday of February through the last Saturday in February as “FFA Week”;  October 12 as “Farmer’s Day”;  The week ending with the second Saturday of March as “4-H Week”;  The first full week of August as “National Farmers Market Week”; and  The second full week of November as “Ohio Soil Health Week,” to celebrate and raise awareness of the importance of soil health to Ohio agriculture and in honor of the birthday…

rollCalls.title: Make appropriations for Bureau of Workers' Comp for FY 2026-27
rollCalls.summary: Prison Industries Enhancement Certification Program. Makes changes to the Prison Industries Enhancement Certification Program, including requiring an injured incarcerated worker to request the Department of Rehabilitation and Correction (DRC) to file a claim with the Bureau of Workers’ Compensation (BWC) on the worker’s behalf and having DRC cover claim costs. PEO and AEO reporting and disclosure requirements.

rollCalls.title: Designate the Freedom Parkway
Revise solid waste and construction and demolition debris laws
rollCalls.summary: Construction and demolition debris (C&DD) fees. Authorizes a solid waste management district (SWMD) to levy fees on the disposal of C&DD (mirroring current SWMD solid waste disposal fees) in an authorized county, which is a county that has a population between 53,000 and 58,000, according to the most recent decennial census. Phases-in the new fee over a three-year period. Requires the SWMD to forward 25% of the new fees to the Ohio Environmental Protection Agency.

rollCalls.title: Specify persons unlawfully present are not privileged from arrest
rollCalls.summary: Requires state and local public offices and public officials to allow the arrest or detention of any person who is, or is suspected of being, unlawfully present in the U.S. for the person’s removal (deportation) or for other immigration-related purposes or proceedings. Allows such an arrest or detention to happen anywhere in Ohio under any circumstances, notwithstanding the continuing law that extends a privilege from arrest in certain cases.

rollCalls.title: Create Election Integrity Unit; revise election law prosecution
rollCalls.summary: Creates the Election Integrity Unit in the Office of the Secretary of State, which was created in similar, but not identical, form as part of H.B. 96 of the 136th General Assembly.

rollCalls.title: Designate Congressman David Hobson Memorial Highway
rollCalls.summary: Designates multiple highways, an interchange, bridge, and overpass. Creates multiple new specialty license plates.

rollCalls.title: Create the Ohio NAACP license plate
Make state operating appropriations for FY 2026-27
rollCalls.summary: This analysis is arranged by state agency in alphabetical order. Items that do not directly involve an agency are located under the agency that has regulatory authority over the item or otherwise deals with the subject matter of the item. After the last agency (the Department of Youth Services), separate chapters address the following: 1. Election Law, addressing the replacement of the Ohio Elections Commission and other elections matters; 2. Sports facilities and unclaimed funds; 3. Boards and commissions; 4. Local government; 5.
